I built a habit tracker this weekend. I thought the hard part would be the streak counter, but it was explaining what happens when someone misses a day.

My first version reset the streak to zero. A friend tried it and said that made them want to stop using it. I changed the screen to show completed days alongside the streak.

This proves everyone prefers encouragement over accountability.

What do you think?
audience: Product managers learning to build small apps
goal: Share a product lesson and invite other people's experiences
preserve: Keep the first-person story and the detail about resetting the streak. Do not invent user research.
